# Bands of the three powers and heights

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`bands-of-the-three-powers` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](bands-of-the-three-powers.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The bands of the three powers (first and second, third and fourth, fifth and top) and the heights are two divisions of the places: together they fix a place, neither is a function of the other, and each band spans one seam, the band of man the junction of the halves.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Two places with the same band and the same height are one place; the band of each place and the seam of each band are listed, each band spanning exactly its seam; no map from heights gives bands and none from bands gives heights. (`Becoming.Hexagram.Band`, `Becoming.Hexagram.bandOf`, `Becoming.Hexagram.bandSeam`, `Becoming.Hexagram.bands_and_heights`, `Becoming.Hexagram.band_seams`, `Becoming.Hexagram.band_seam_unique`, `Becoming.Hexagram.neither_function`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; the six places and their heights as defined in HexagramPlaces.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the three powers are heaven, man and earth in any sense beyond the division.
